title: Maintenance AI Knowledge Freshness Master Roadmap
goal: Ensure the maintenance AI keeps Odysseus' self-knowledge, tool index, tool usage memory chunks, and RaptorGraph capability facts current after every update.

source_roadmaps.title: Tool Capability Refresh After Updates
source_roadmaps.summary: Post-update refresh script, ToolIndex refresh, tool capability latest/history packet, generated memory-record chunks, RaptorGraph event packet, and capability-question provider context.

source_roadmaps.title: Tool Capability Maintenance Phase 2
source_roadmaps.summary: Live post-update smoke, idempotent Memory writes, RaptorGraph event-store integration, self-report guard, diagnostics readback, and final Telegram/chat acceptance.

master_lanes.name: Update Hook And ToolIndex Refresh
evidence: Commit cf4193c2 pushed to fuzzy/dev.
scripts/refresh_tool_capability_knowledge.py exists.
ops/homeserver/install-auto-update-timer.sh calls the refresh after version and Chroma readiness.
TCM2-6 regression test now proves the refresh stays after App/Chroma readiness and version verification.
master_lanes.remaining: Deploy latest fuzzy/dev to Debian and run live smoke.

master_lanes.name: Tool Capability Knowledge Artifacts
evidence: data/tool_capability_knowledge/latest.json is the target latest packet.
history.jsonl appends durable refresh history.
Generated records use source=tool_capability_maintenance and category=system_capability.

master_lanes.name: Memory Truth Write Integration
master_lanes.done_when: Generated tool usage memory chunks are written idempotently into native Memory/vector lanes when the system-memory write gate is open.
evidence: Tool capability memory write executor is implemented with dry-run default, write gate, idempotent memory_id upsert, optional vector update, and provenance logging.
refresh_tool_capability_knowledge.py supports gated --write-memory execution and dry-run proof.
Focused suite passed with 26 tests.
master_lanes.remaining: Enable the write gate on Debian and run a live bounded smoke only after operator Go.

master_lanes.name: RaptorGraph Tool Capability Integration
master_lanes.done_when: Every accepted refresh creates or dedupes a RaptorGraph capability event linked to snapshot id, commit, and memory record ids.
evidence: Tool capability RaptorGraph append store writes redacted JSONL events with stable tool-rg ids and duplicate detection.
RaptorGraph appends record raptorgraph_mutation provenance without raw private content.
refresh_tool_capability_knowledge.py supports gated --write-raptorgraph execution and dry-run proof.
Focused suite passed with 27 tests.
master_lanes.remaining: Enable the RaptorGraph write gate on Debian and run a live bounded smoke only after operator Go.

master_lanes.name: Agent Self-Report Freshness Guard
evidence: Context orchestrator injects tool capability provider payload for capability/tool/file/git questions.
Capability questions now receive a Tool capability self-report guard system message grounded in core.tool_capability_knowledge.
Regression coverage proves the guard includes current read_file, bash, and manage_repos context.
master_lanes.remaining: Confirm via live Telegram/chat acceptance after Debian deploy.

master_lanes.name: Updater Regression Coverage
evidence: tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py covers post-readiness tool capability refresh ordering.
Focused suite passed with 18 tests.

master_lanes.name: Diagnostics And Audit Readback
master_lanes.done_when: Backend diagnostics can report latest snapshot, index status, memory write status, graph event status, and freshness.
evidence: read_tool_capability_diagnostics reports latest snapshot id, timestamp, commit, index status, memory chunk count/ids, and RaptorGraph event/store status.
GET /api/diagnostics/tool-capabilities is admin-gated and redacted.
Focused suite passed with 29 tests.
master_lanes.remaining: Confirm the route against the live Debian deployment after pushing and deploying latest fuzzy/dev.

master_lanes.name: Live Debian And Telegram Acceptance
master_lanes.done_when: After an update, Odysseus answers tool/capability questions from current knowledge and no longer reports present tools as missing.

global_gates.decision_needed: Allow deploying latest fuzzy/dev to Debian and running the post-update refresh.
Confirm that system capability chunks may be written automatically because they contain no private user content.
Confirm that tool capability graph events are allowed as maintenance metadata.

tomorrow_execution_order: Memory write executor binding is repo-done; run live gated smoke later.
RaptorGraph/event-store integration is repo-done; run live gated smoke later.
Agent self-report guard is repo-done; verify with Telegram/chat after deploy.
Diagnostics readback is repo-done; run live readback after deploy.
Deploy to Debian after operator Go.
Ask Odysseus via Telegram/chat what tools and repo/file capabilities it has.
non_goals: No UI placement or UI implementation.
No edits to static/frontpage-v2/app.js or legacy UI files.
No raw private document, chat, Telegram, token, secret, or absolute host path persistence.
No Docker-first implementation; Podman is the runtime assumption.
No broad MCP or host shell exposure.
success_definition: After every update, Odysseus can refresh and retrieve current tool capability knowledge, write safe tool-usage chunks to Memory/RaptorGraph when gates allow it, and accurately answer capability questions from current state.
